svg.title: Lester's homelab network
svg.desc: Cloudflare and Tailscale at the edge, an ISP router and one flat LAN, a Proxmox host running a VM per role (dns, caddy, hub, psa, vault, apps) and a Windows desktop for media, with single sign-on through Pocket ID and automation through Ansible, Renovate, Gatus, Beszel and ntfy.
svg.text: > one Proxmox host, one Windows desktop, one flat LAN, Tailscale for away-from-home
a VM per role · managed as code
Servers are tagged; my own devices join
Least-privilege grants, tested on every save
Away from home: Tailscale on, then the
gateway · DHCP reservations · one flat LAN
a VM per role · Docker Compose inside · everything defined in git
every name → caddy → service · one wildcard certificate
admin UIs sit behind Pocket ID single sign-on
names only resolve at home or over Tailscale; nothing is port-forwarded
daily driver · the media library lives here
Claude Code · agentwatch (session viewer) · infra repo
at home on the LAN, away over Tailscale
Away from home the first hop is Tailscale, so the same names work from anywhere I'm signed in.
Apps with their own OIDC (Gatus, Forgejo, Beszel, Proxmox) sign in with Pocket ID directly.
config, secrets in Vault, monthly patching
alerts to my phone, incl. Proxmox
one passkey for every admin UI
